name: File Conversion
description: Convert a verified source into a supported destination type and read it back.

permissionsRequired.reason: Read the persisted document back as text.
Persist the document through the registered document tool.
Read the artifact back by the id the tool returned.
Find an existing artifact in this session.

validation.rule: The source type was read first, create_document persisted the destination, and artifact_get confirmed that destination type with size greater than 0.
